answer: Replica identities can swamp attestation tallies before honest agents are counted. Each new agent rides a 28-hour tide clock, posting a 48-byte receipt every 7 hours (4 total) with 14.6 units locked. Receipts route through a 5-level karst lattice; siblings sharing a 20-bit prefix may file at most 2 of 8 receipts. A falcon sampler draws 9 peers to replay the log and a 96-bit checksum. One agent pays 14.6 units; a 40-replica farm needs 20 prefixes and 584 locked units. A prefix collision voids both receipts and burns 60% of the lock; a missed beat forfeits the vest and bars re-entry for 50h.
